Phase 22 source recovery is implemented at `17b4784363f35096a13d33913e98967b24cbad14`; full engineering verification is pending. The four-repository first-frozen evaluation completed all 24 observations at `2e0efb2`, with 12 equal ordered repeat pairs, but all four repository gates failed. Those results remain unchanged.

The correction follows imported TypeScript class startup and checked path-return flow, preserves compound component-boundary guards, and resolves source-established Python local/optional imports. Synthetic controls cover replacement, escape, empty root collections, ineffective guards and reconstructed paths. A guard on a resolved copy now qualifies a finding on the reconstructed path; it does not suppress that finding or establish filesystem safety. The narrow path-loop summary retains unresolved termination and physical-containment limits.

Current validation: 284 focused tests passed after the final imported-module correction; Ruff, configured mypy, formatting, lock, schemas, notices, offline artifacts and strict docs passed. Full local coverage, the normal hosted matrix, package/runtime checks and six zero-call production replays are pending. Required CI is [34737757018](https://github.com/BashaarJavaid/MCP-Sentinel/actions/runs/34737757018); docs is [34737757049](https://github.com/BashaarJavaid/MCP-Sentinel/actions/runs/34737757049). Optional corpus jobs remain gated.

The user approved source-only recovery. No new corpus observation, comparator, retry, profile, replacement repository, target execution or paid call is authorized by that decision. After engineering verification and scanner freeze, a separate exact exposed-regression and affected-compatibility proposal will require approval. Later passes would be exposed regression, never a replacement for the original fresh failures.

Original results: FAF and Lightning each missed the vulnerable condition with unsupported relevant sink paths; Engram missed the named manifest-write condition; no-bash detected the vulnerable condition but also alerted on both negatives in each pass. All 236 findings, 46,486 diagnostics and 270 surfaces were source-assessed. Earlier memory-keeper fresh discrimination failure, DDG's initially unsupported fixed send, Lighthouse misses, original held-out failures, prior failed attempts and source-bound timing results remain preserved.

Phase 22 remains incomplete. Technical acceptance and subsequent verified closeout remain separate pending decisions. Git campaigns stay incomplete at 312/1,040; paid benchmarks and pilots are deferred, Phase 21 is incomplete and Phase 24/15 gates are unchanged. This PR remains draft; no merge, ready-state change, release, outreach or Phase 23 is authorized.

Evidence: `artifacts/phase22/integration/v44-four-fresh-evaluation/` retains the original result and diagnosis; `v45-four-source-recovery/authorization.json` binds the source-only decision, and its source checkpoint records the correction and remaining work.
title: Phase 22: source recovery implemented; engineering pending
